baseline.fingerprintEncoding: SHA-256 of compact insertion-order JSON (ensure_ascii=False; separators comma/colon).

blockers.finding: Each stem says every operation follows a fixed named sequence, identifies the one bounded variation, and labels the invariant/common workflow before asking which design preserves it. For example i001 says only conflict-summary format varies and the shared workflow owns the no-silent-overwrite invariant. The stem discloses the Template Method answer shape rather than testing the choice.

The wrong-option feedback uses malformed template joins such as “shared conflicts are explicit and never silently overwrite accepted geometry” and “shared the escalation keeps ownership…”, so it does not diagnose a coherent competing design.

summary.minimumCorrection: Keep observable scenario constraints, but remove the explicit “fixed sequence/only this varies/shared workflow owns invariant” solution recipe; leave the learner to infer which boundary fits. Repair every keyed message so it names the actual failure without mechanically inserting the invariant phrase into ungrammatical prose. Preserve question IDs: predecessor and current keyed answers both represent Template Method/fixed-skeleton decisions. Current option IDs are case-specific.
